msg: Good afternoon. I am from Germany and I hold an Open Water certification, although I have not dived for three years. I am staying in Getsemaní and I would like to dive next Wednesday. My flight home leaves on Thursday at 22:00. Is this possible, and what would you recommend?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Good afternoon! A refresher is a great way to get comfortable again after three years without diving. Since you’re certified, the refresher is the right option to consider.

Your Thursday 22:00 flight is more than 18 hours after a daytime refresher on Wednesday, so the flight timing works. The 18-hour wait is counted from your last dive, not from when the boat returns to Cartagena. From Cartagena, the activity ends around 12:00–1:00 p.m., and the boat returns around 4:15 p.m.

The refresher is booked as the Dive Mini Course, but certified divers still need to wait 18 hours before flying. You can choose Wednesday and the number of participants here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en

The booking system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before for next-day bookings.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

Would you like help with anything else about the refresher?

msg: Thank you. What exactly does the refresher consist of? I would prefer to do proper dives on Wednesday: could I do a short review with the guide in the morning and then the 2 dives on the same day? I could also come on Tuesday if necessary.
reply:
The refresher includes a pool session with theory and confined-water practice, followed by *one reef dive* with a PADI instructor. It isn’t a short review followed by two fun dives on the same day; the refresher itself includes one ocean dive.

For two proper dives, the Cartagena Fun Dives trip includes *two dives at different sites*. Since you haven’t dived for three years, a refresher is normally required before returning to recreational dives. The refresher is a one-day activity, so Tuesday could be an option before diving on Wednesday, but please note that certified divers need to wait at least *18 hours after their last dive before flying*. The refresher’s last dive is around noon–1:00 p.m., so a Tuesday refresher followed by Wednesday dives would also mean your Thursday 22:00 flight is more than 18 hours after the Wednesday dives only if those dives finish by 4:00 a.m. Thursday; please have a team advisor confirm the schedule and flight timing before booking.

The refresher meets at Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m.; the boat returns to Cartagena at about 4:15 p.m. It includes the boat, equipment, lunch, insurance, park entrance fee, pool session and one reef dive. It does not include transport to the dock or underwater photos/videos.

How many people would this be for: just you, or more? 😊

msg: Just me. I am sorry, I do not understand the part about 4:00 a.m. Let me ask it plainly: if I do the refresher on Tuesday and the 2 dives on Wednesday, is my flight on Thursday at 22:00 fine or not?
reply:
Yes—if you do the refresher on Tuesday and your two dives on Wednesday, your Thursday 22:00 flight meets the required 18-hour wait, based on the Wednesday dives finishing around 4:15 p.m. The earlier 4:00 a.m. reference was incorrect—sorry for the confusion.

✅ *Refresher added* — it is the mini-course: pool training and one dive with an instructor, on its own day. It costs *183 USD* per person who needs it. Book it here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en

🤿 *Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day)*
💰 *178 USD* per person (online rate)
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, mandatory dive insurance, speedboat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, 2 guided dives with a certified PADI professional, diving equipment, lunch and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

Is there anything else I can help you with? I can *add another activity*, answer questions, or adjust your booking. 🤿

msg: Good, thank you. Two last questions: do you pick me up in Getsemaní or how do I reach the dock, and do I have to bring my certification card or fill in any forms for these two days?
reply:
There’s no hotel pick-up in Getsemaní. Please make your own way to *Muelle de la Bodeguita* for the *8:00 a.m.* departure; it’s about five minutes from the historic center. Ground transport to the dock isn’t included. You can find it here: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Muelle+de+la+Bodeguita/@10.4199447,-75.5537609,828m/data=!3m2!1e3!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x8ef62f753729822d:0x1bbcdd8224d0eaaf!8m2!3d10.4199447!4d-75.551186!16s%2Fg%2F113gzkckf?entry=ttu

Please bring your *certification card* for the two-dive trip. You can show it on the day or send a photo beforehand.

For the *refresher*, complete the course medical form: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (it’s in Spanish). For the insurance, complete the form included in your booking confirmation email. The team will also send you a liability waiver for the certified dives; if you haven’t completed the forms, check your confirmation email for reminders.

You'll also need:
• There is no theory to do beforehand: it is done there, on the day, with the instructor.
• If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly.
• After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying
• Minimum age: 10 and over.
• For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.
